designationHistory.indexText: The Omnibus Public Land Management Act of 2009 established Prehistoric Trackways National Monument in New Mexico.

authority.citation: Public Law 111-11, title II, sec. 2103, 123 Stat. 991, 1097

designationHistory.note: Established by statute, not under the Antiquities Act. The BLM unit page gives no designation date.

sources.name: 54 U.S.C. 320301 notes, national monuments list (Cornell LII)
